title: 2 Minnesota women plead guilty in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
notes: Dates Ayan Jama's plea to Friday, February 3, 2025 -- one day off from src-postbulletin-2025-02-05-jama-brava-pleas, which dates the same plea to January 31, 2025. Preserved as an unresolved minor date discrepancy, not silently corrected either direction. Also covers Mekfira Hussein (Shamsia Hopes), a separate, unrelated Feeding Our Future defendant not otherwise addressed by this record.
supports: Ayan Jama, 45, of Rochester, manager of Brava Restaurant, pleaded guilty on February 3, 2025 to one count each of wire fraud and money laundering.
Brava and an associated restaurant submitted fake attendance records claiming more than 1.7 million meals served, obtaining $4.3 million plus $900,000 from 'another restaurant.'
